mainEntity.name: How do I download a Facebook ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Find the ad in the Meta Ad Library, copy the link of its details page (it contains ?id=) or its library ID, paste it into the tool and click the download button. The file lands in your browser, with no account and no extension.

mainEntity.name: Can I download an Instagram ad with this tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the ad runs on Instagram: Meta keeps Facebook and Instagram ads in the same library. Search for the advertiser in the Meta Ad Library and paste the ad link. Organic Instagram posts aren’t supported.

mainEntity.name: Where do I find the ID of a Facebook ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Meta Ad Library, every ad shows its library ID on its card. It also appears at the end of the address of the ad details page, after ?id=.

mainEntity.name: Can I download carousels and dynamic creatives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The tool shows each card or variant with its own creative, headline and link, and one button grabs every creative at once.

mainEntity.name: In what quality is the video downloaded?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the qualities Meta offers for that ad, usually an HD and an SD version. The tool only shows files that actually exist.
Creative links are signed by Meta and expire. Run the search again to get fresh links. If the message says no ad was found, check the ID: the ad may have been removed from the library.

mainEntity.name: Am I allowed to reuse a downloaded Facebook ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ad remains the property of its advertiser. You can download it to analyse it and learn from its structure, but not republish it as is in your own campaigns.

mainEntity.name: Is this Facebook ads downloader free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, free and with no account. Files come from Meta’s servers and no creative is stored on our side.

step.name: Find the ad in the Meta Ad Library
step.text: In the Meta Ad Library, search for a brand or a keyword, filter by country, then spot the ad you want.

step.name: Copy its link or ID
step.text: Open the ad details and copy the address containing ?id=, or copy the library ID shown on the ad.

step.name: Paste the link and download
step.text: Paste the link into the tool, run the search and download the video, the image or every creative of the carousel.
